svg.data-what: the brain seen from its left side, the front to the left: the four lobes of the cerebrum, the cerebellum and the brain stem

g.data-what: the brain stem: pons and medulla, joining the brain to the spinal cord; breathing and heartbeat are run from here
the cerebellum, under the back of the brain: balance, posture, smooth timing of movement
the frontal lobe: planning, decisions, movement, speech (Broca's area, low on the left side)
the parietal lobe: touch, the body's position, space and attention
the temporal lobe: hearing, language understanding (Wernicke's area), memory with the hippocampus inside it

path.data-what: the primary motor cortex, the strip in front of the central sulcus that commands voluntary movement
the primary somatosensory cortex, the strip behind the central sulcus that receives touch from the body
the central sulcus, the groove between the frontal and parietal lobes
the lateral (Sylvian) fissure, the deep groove above the temporal lobe
where the parietal, temporal and occipital lobes meet: borders drawn by convention, not grooves
